prediction.text:
Exxon says the Pioneer acquisition, which closed in May 2024, was a main driver of higher 2024 production. Total oil-equivalent production was 4,333 thousand barrels a day in 2024, up from 3,738 in 2023, an increase of 595 thousand barrels a day. The filings do not give a Pioneer-only volume, so Pioneer's exact share of the increase can't be separated out.
Exxon said it closed the Pioneer acquisition in May 2024, 'significantly increasing our Permian footprint'. It also said total 2024 production averaged about 1,185 koebd, approximately 570 koebd higher than the previous year. This figure comes from the Key Recent Events discussion of the Permian, so it appears to be Permian production, not company-wide.
Company-wide oil-equivalent production was 4,333 thousand barrels a day in 2024, against 3,738 in 2023. Exxon said 2024 production of 4.3 million barrels a day increased 595 thousand barrels a day from 2023. It said Permian and Guyana production grew by 680 thousand barrels a day, 'more than offsetting impacts from divestments and entitlements'.
The 2023 baseline was oil-equivalent production of 3,738 koebd, 'in line with 2022'. Permian production was about 610 koebd in 2023. In October 2023 Exxon announced the all-stock Pioneer deal, valued at $59.5 billion, which it said would more than double its Permian footprint.
Exxon attributed higher advantaged-volume earnings in 2024 to 'record production in Permian, driven by the Pioneer acquisition and growth in the heritage Permian'.
In the second-quarter 2024 10-Q, Exxon said production of 4.4 million barrels a day was up 750 thousand barrels a day from 2Q 2023. It said this was 'driven by the Pioneer acquisition and record production in Guyana and heritage Permian'. Heritage Permian excludes the assets acquired from Pioneer, which closed May 3, 2024.

caveats: The filings retrieved give no Pioneer-only production figure, so the Pioneer contribution is not isolated from Guyana and heritage Permian growth.
The Pioneer deal closed on May 3, 2024, so 2024 includes only about eight months of Pioneer volumes.
